title: Select Research picker: technology text back, less vertical space
description: The phone compaction (EO) hid every technology's own text, and the top area still spent a lot of height: a 16 px flex gap from the generic dialog class sat above Tech Skips and above the filters, the skip pills were 44 px (30 px on desktop), the Tech Skips hint stacked under its title, and in landscape the filter row fell out of the left column (cut off at the bottom) and the confirm button was clipped. Now the text is shown again on every card (phones: a clamped 3 line paragraph with a More / Less link, desktop: full text as before), the Players row and subtitle stay hidden on phones, the gaps are gone, skip pills are 34 px on phones (26 px on desktop) and the landscape left column holds header, skips, status, confirm button and filter without clipping. Before shots are taken on release-2026-10-16 (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- EX. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: phone portrait, with tech skips
shots.caption: No technology text on any card; 16 px bands above Tech Skips and above the filter chips; 44 px skip pills. First technology (Advanced Carrier II) starts at y = 336.

shots.heading: After: phone portrait, with tech skips
shots.caption: Card text is back (3 lines, More link where it is longer), skip pills 34 px, no empty bands. First technology at y = 272 (-64 px).

shots.heading: Before: phone portrait, no tech skips
shots.caption: First technology at y = 307.

shots.heading: After: phone portrait, no tech skips
shots.caption: First technology at y = 253 (-54 px), with its text.

shots.heading: Before: phone landscape, with tech skips
shots.caption: Left column: skip pills stacked one per line, Available cut off, no confirm button reachable, filter chips clipped at the bottom of the screen.

shots.heading: After: phone landscape, with tech skips
shots.caption: Two skip pills per line, Available / Selected / Select Technology all visible, filter chips directly below; technology text on the right.

shots.heading: Before: phone landscape, no tech skips
shots.caption: Same clipping without skips.

shots.heading: After: phone landscape, no tech skips
shots.caption: Left column ends at y = 169 instead of 220, filter in view.

shots.heading: Before: desktop, with tech skips
shots.caption: 30 px of empty space above the Tech Skips box, 16 px above the filters, hint stacked under the title, 30 px skip pills. First technology at y = 410.

shots.heading: After: desktop, with tech skips
shots.caption: Header, box and filters sit tight, hint inline with the title, 26 px skip pills. First technology at y = 332 (-78 px). Roster, subtitle and full texts unchanged.

notes.title: What had disappeared
notes.text: Commit a45d59b7 (screenshots EO-phone-tech-compact) added .technology-card__effect to the phone rule that hides the roster and subtitle. That element is every technology's own rules text (tech.meta.description); names, prerequisites and Researched-by were kept. The CSS rule is gone; the text is rendered again on phones.

notes.title: Judgement
notes.text: Felix asked to drop the description of what a technology does from the header (the subtitle) and keep the players row hidden; both stay hidden. The cards' own text is not a header and returns. To keep the list short, on phones the text is clamped to 3 lines at 12.5 px; when it is really cut off a More / Less link (not a card tap, which selects the technology) shows the rest. Desktop never clamps.

notes.title: Skip pills
notes.text: 34 px high on phones instead of 44 (they are wide, 100+ px), 26 px on desktop instead of 30. This relaxes the 44 px rule of the BB check for .tech-skip-pill only; filter chips and buttons stay at 44 px.

notes.title: Measured heights (px above the first technology card)
notes.text: Desktop with skips 410 -> 332, without 409 -> 321. Phone portrait 390x844 with skips 336 -> 272, without 307 -> 253. Landscape 844x390: the left column (header + skips + status + button) is 220 -> 207 px with skips and 220 -> 169 without, and now also contains the filter chips and the confirm button, which were clipped before.
